versions.changelog:
Initial public release with major rewrite and expanded documentation.

- Added 75 new files, including detailed docs, CLI scripts, and MCP adapters.
- Introduced a local-first MCP stdio memory backend for coding agents, supporting Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
- Provided auto-organization features: classification, deduplication, superseding, quarantining, and rollback of agent memories.
- Added tools for reading, searching, writing, updating, and deleting shared memories, plus semantic checks and provider installation.
- Updated documentation to include install instructions, agent MCP integration guide, and privacy policy.
- Switched license to MIT and added project and contribution metadata.

- Improved documentation in SKILL.md: added detailed usage instructions, safety and payment guidelines, supported commands, and both English and Chinese sections.
- Clarified operating rules, safety contract, and payment boundaries for both CLI and MCP use.
- No changes to code or functionality noted.

Initial release of MemoryGuard: agent instruction, memory, and governance auditing with optional billing support.

- Audits, organizes, and governs agent instructions, skills, permissions, local RAG data, and MCP memory layers.
- Provides CLI tools and MCP stdio server for secure memory management (read, write, search, update, delete, rollback).
- Supports multi-agent shared-memory, provenance, versioning, quarantining, and reversible governance actions.
- Integrates optionally with external SkillPay billing for write operations, with user-configurable billing modes.
- Enforces security by never storing secrets or API keys within the skill or repository.
